Momentum (momentum.io), a San Francisco company founded in 2020 by Santiago Suarez Ordoñez, Ashley Wilson and Moiz Virani that turns sales calls, emails and Slack into structured revenue data. Raised a $5M seed led by Basis Set Ventures (closed Aug 2021, announced Nov 10, 2021) and a $13M Series A led by FirstMark Capital with Stage 2 Capital (July 2024), which brought total funding to $18M. Salesforce signed a definitive agreement to acquire Momentum on Feb 18, 2026 and completed the deal on March 2, 2026 (terms not disclosed).
